defect_diagnosis.description: Package 92 utilized a mixed-donor state: nodal displacements U1, U2 and damage d were interpolated from Package 90-R1 (Frame 6, RF2 = 159.16 N, d_max = 0.9730), while Gauss-point history H was interpolated from Package 91 (Frame 6, RF2 = 162.93 N, d_max = 0.9494).
defect_diagnosis.root_cause: Package 91 was formulated with an overtightened crack-band corridor (clamping 2,420 nodes vs 2,221 in Package 90-R1), altering boundary kinematics and stiffening the specimen by +2.37% (159.16 N -> 162.93 N). Combining Package 90-R1 displacements with Package 91 history created a thermodynamic mismatch between strain energy psi_0^+(eps) and historical maximum H.
defect_diagnosis.resolution_strategy: Package 92-R1 will be formulated with a 100% self-consistent donor state derived directly from Package 90-R1 Frame 6: evaluate Gauss-point history H(x) = max(H_prior, psi_0^+(eps(u))) directly from Package 90-R1 displacements using the UEL constitutive relation, ensuring strict thermodynamic and kinematic consistency across all 17,688 Gauss points of Candidate C4.
